observation_summary: The system throws an IndexOutOfBoundsException when attempting to remove a column or value that does not exist or has already been removed, because the code lacks validation checks for the existence of keys before performing removal operations.
reasoning_summary: The fix involves adding explicit checks (if-statements) to validate the presence of keys and handle null arguments before proceeding with data structure modifications. This prevents the IndexOutOfBoundsException and ensures proper error handling, which is the definition of a Checking defect.
evidence_used: The fix adds 'if (columnKey == null)' and 'if (!this.columnKeys.contains(columnKey))' checks in DefaultKeyedValues2D.removeColumn.
The fix adds a check 'if (index >= 0)' before calling rowData.removeValue in DefaultKeyedValues2D.removeColumn.
The fix adds an exception throw for unknown keys in DefaultKeyedValues.removeValue.
The stack traces show IndexOutOfBoundsException occurring during removal operations.

alternative_types.why_not_primary: While the removal logic was flawed, the root cause was the absence of guard conditions to validate the state before executing the removal, rather than an error in the removal algorithm itself.
